question: Let $P(2,3,5)$ and $Q(5,7,9)$ be two points in space. A line passes through $P$ and is parallel to vector $2\hat{i} + 5\hat{j} + 7\hat{k}$. Which of the following is the vector equation of this line?
explanation:
The vector equation of a line passing through a point $P(x_1,y_1,z_1)$ and parallel to direction vector $(a,b,c)$ is given by:

$\vec r = (x_1\hat i + y_1\hat j + z_1\hat k) + \lambda(a\hat i + b\hat j + c\hat k)$.

Here the point is $P(2,3,5)$ and direction vector is $(2,5,7)$.

Thus the equation becomes $\vec r = (2\hat i + 3\hat j + 5\hat k) + \lambda(2\hat i + 5\hat j + 7\hat k)$.

Hence option B is correct.
